thread:
Emily (PM): Quick sync — we need to finalize the tiny, high-impact scope for the Console observability deliverable next sprint. Focus: dashboards (cost + error), tracing hooks, and a compact latency/cost decision matrix.
Rajesh (Eng): I can take a cut at the decision matrix and a minimal tracing hook API. thinking minimal surface: 1) event hook, 2) sample config, 3) rollout flag.
Marie (Observability): Agree on minimal tracing. We also need the dashboard wireframes for cost and error by model/route. One page per customer slice.
Samir (SRE): Prioritize alerts for high-error-rate routes and token-rate spikes. Can we reuse existing alerting infra? yes but need tracing IDs attached to metrics.
Olivia (Data): For cost breakdown, we need token attribution to model+route and percent of cached hits vs new inference. small CSV export would help early customers.
Emily (PM): Good. Proposing acceptance criteria (must-haves) for launch:
- Cost dashboard shows model/route/day and top-10 customers by spend.
- Error dashboard has per-route error rate and linked trace IDs.
- Tracing hooks emit trace IDs with every generation request and expose a sampling toggle.
- Decision matrix doc with guidance: when to use caching vs higher qps batching vs cheaper quantized variants.
Marie (Observability): Can we keep the tracing hook API to a single header to start? e.g. X-Redwood-Trace: <id> or server generates.
Rajesh (Eng): yep. Minimal API: header optional. If absent, generate trace id. SDKs will pass it through.
Samir (SRE): For rollout, require a "observability:on" feature flag per deployment to opt-in. helps limited tenant rollouts.
Emily (PM): Risk checklist quick scan: data privacy for per-customer spend, storage retention for traces, perf overhead of tracing.
Olivia (Data): Retention: keep full traces 7 days by default, aggregated metrics 90 days. Export job for long-term billing.
Rajesh (Eng): Perf note: make KV cache and tracing orthogonal; ensure tracing headers don't block batching. We'll add microbench markers.
Marie (Observability): UX ask: dashboard row should include quick links: "Open trace" and "Export CSV".
Emily (PM): Prioritization: must have vs nice-to-have draft:
- Must: trace header, per-route error rates, model-based cost breakdown, basic decision matrix doc.
- Nice: customer-level spend drilldown, A/B rollout insights, auto-alert tuning.
Rajesh (Eng): Proposed timeline: week 1: API + hooks + small bench. week 2: metrics pipeline + dashboards initial. week 3: polish + docs + canary.
Samir (SRE): Canary plan: enable on 5 internal tenants + 3 pilot customers. watch: p50/p95 latency, error increase, token cost variance.
Emily (PM): Launch criteria (go/no-go): all must-haves implemented, SRE smoke tests pass, docs + short runbook, 2 pilot customers onboarded.
Olivia (Data): Quick sample SQL for cost breakdown (we'll shape later):
```
SELECT date, model, route, SUM(tokens) as tokens, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM billing_events
WHERE date >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY date, model, route
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 100;
```
Marie (Observability): tiny config example for tracing sampling in YAML:
```
observability:
  tracing:
    enabled: true
    sample_rate: 0.05
    header_key: X-Redwood-Trace
```
Rajesh (Eng): I'll open the PR for hook impl + benchmark tomorrow. tagging in code review: @Marie @Samir.
Samir (SRE): I'll draft the SLO smoke checklist and alert thresholds.
Emily (PM): OK team — next steps: Rajesh PR, Marie wireframe mocks in figma, Olivia sample export job, Samir canary plan. We'll review on Wed sync. Thanks :rocket: 
deploy-bot: New canary featureflag "obs-mini" created for rollout testing.
Emily (PM): noted, assigning pilot list in GH issue.
Rajesh (Eng): quick question — do we want quantization recommendations in decision matrix now or defer? I vote defer to later iteration (we can include high-level notes).
Olivia (Data): high-level ok now, deep recommendations later.
Emily (PM): Decision: include high-level quantization notes (cost vs quality) in matrix, defer per-model quantization tables until post-launch.
Marie (Observability): I'll also add acceptance test snippets for trace linkage in the docs. example assertion: trace_id present in metric labels.
Emily (PM): Perfect. Closing thread: please add any blockers before EOD.
Rajesh (Eng): none from me.
Samir (SRE): will flag if infra quota shows issues during bench.
Olivia (Data): prepping sample data extract now.
Marie (Observability): starting mocks.
Emily (PM): thanks team :thumbsup:
